results.releaseNotes:
iPhone / iPad / Mac
- New text size setting: scale the app's text from Extra Small to Extra Large, independent of your iOS Dynamic Type setting.
- New "Wind Only" option for the Wind layer — view wind speed without the animated particles.
- Updated default color palettes for Reflectivity, Velocity, and other radar layers.
- Fixed lightning strikes not showing up in some areas, including the Last Strike tile and Watch complication.
- Fixed duplicate "Current Location" entries appearing in your saved locations.
- Fixed a dropped first tap when opening layer settings.
- Fixed the resize handle on iPad's Classic mode panel not responding to drags.
- Improved stability and performance on older and low-memory devices.

Watch
- Your current location now updates on the watch itself as you move, without waiting for your iPhone.
results.description:
Welcome to the NEW Storm Radar, the next generation of weather radar and storm tracking. We’ve re-imagined the app with smarter insights, powerful tools, and a fresh design built on the trusted accuracy of The Weather Channel.

POWERFUL WEATHER & RADAR FEATURES
• Expanded weather map layers: Wind, lightning, tropical tracks, hail, and more
• Advanced high-resolution single site radar for crystal-clear storm visualization
• AI Weather Assistant™: Your personal meteorologist for real-time insights
• Smarter storm alerts: Rain alerts, NOAA severe weather warnings, and more

PLAN AHEAD WITH POWERFUL WEATHER INTELLIGENCE
• Visualize changing weather patterns and incoming wind and rain in vivid detail
• Know exactly when and where the storm will hit with 6 hours of global future radar, and up to 72 hours of future radar in US.
• Get real-time precipitation alerts before the rain begins

STAY SAFE WITH REAL-TIME STORM TRACKING
• Receive live local storm warnings, watches, and advisories
• Get lightning alerts for your location
• Customize map layers to track severe conditions like hurricanes, tropical storms, tornadoes, and cyclones
• Use Storm Tracks to understand storm motion and intensity with up to 30 advanced tracking features

SEE MORE WITH DETAILED WEATHER DATA
• Add overlays such as wind speed, temperature, and more to your weather radar

GO PREMIUM FOR FULL STORM & WEATHER POWER
Unlock the complete Storm Radar experience to level up your storm tracking experience, with
• High-res Single Site Radar
• Advanced map layers
• 72-Hour Future Radar
• Expanded access to the AI Weather Assistant
• Customizable weather widgets

If you choose to purchase the Premium version of Storm Radar, subscription payments will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of your purchase. 
• Storm subscription auto renews annually. 
• Cancel anytime in Settings > AppleID at least 24 hours before your renewal date to avoid charges. 
• Subscription payments will be charged to your account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term.

PRIVACY
• Our Privacy Policy can be viewed here: https://weather.com/en-US/twc/privacy-policy 
• Our Terms of Use can be viewed here: http://www.weather.com/common/home/legal.html

FEEDBACK 
• Your feedback is important to us! If you love our weather app, please rate and review us in the App Store. 
• If you have any questions or suggestions, please email us at twcstormradar@weather.com
